name: tasty-microfrontends
description: Microfrontends: Angular (Shell) + React (Menú, Sedes, Admin) + Vue (Pedido, Gestión Pedidos)

scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start:angular" "npm run start:react" "npm run start:vue"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd framework_angular && npm ci && cd ../framework_react && npm ci && cd ../framework_vue && npm ci
